author: opencode-worker-7
text: SCOPE COUPLING discovered while scoping this bead: raising LICHEN_WAYPOINT_MAX to the spec's 256 global grows the static store by ~300 bytes/entry (~76KB) — that is exactly the STM32WL RAM-budget decision tracked in worker6-aqk6. Before implementing, aqk6 needs Mark's call (256 entries everywhere vs Kconfig-tunable per board vs dynamic storage). The per-originator 32 accounting and the 5.03 waypoint_limit diagnostic body are decision-free and can land first if this bead is split; the global 256 raise is the aqk6-coupled part.
